subject: Invoice sender & payment collection for CoreFin integration
messages:
From: Sara Hamilton <sara.hamilton@corefin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice sender & payment collection for CoreFin integration

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We're kicking off AP integration planning and need to confirm how Redwood will deliver invoices and who will be the payment collector on invoices to CoreFin Solutions. A few specific asks from our AP team: 

- Can Redwood be the invoice issuer for the monthly usage invoices, or do you require CoreFin to pull via a vendor portal?
- Our ERP currently cannot ingest portal pushes; we prefer emailed PDF invoices to ap@corefin.com unless there's a mandatory API transfer.
- We need the VAT registration proof attached to the first invoice (PDF) and the billing contact listed on the invoice.
- PO attached for reference (CoreFin-PO-7892.pdf).

Would appreciate confirmation of the common path so we can map remittance and PO-match rules.

Best,
Sara Hamilton
Director, Accounts Payable
CoreFin Solutions

Attachment: CoreFin-PO-7892.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hamilton <sara.hamilton@corefin.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice sender & payment collection for CoreFin integration

Sara — thanks for the PO and clear asks. Quick answers and a proposed path: 

1) Default invoice flow: Redwood can issue invoices (Redwood Inference, Inc.) and send a PDF to ap@corefin.com. We also offer portal enrollment but understand your ERP constraint — email PDF is fine as the canonical delivery for now.

2) VAT evidence: we can attach a VAT registration PDF on first invoice and include a line on subsequent invoices referencing the VAT cert stored in our portal. We will need the exact VAT fields you require on the PDF (VAT number location, formatting).

3) Payment collector / remittance: By default invoices will designate Redwood Inference, Inc. as the billed entity and collection beneficiary. If CoreFin needs payments routed to a different collector entity (e.g., a payment processing partner), we need a signed collector authorization and bank remit details.

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly (CC) to confirm the invoice PDF template and VAT attachment process.
- Connor to set up a temporary email-only delivery route and mirror to our portal for future automation.
- Sara: confirm whether your payment team requires a separate collector entity and whether PO number (CoreFin-PO-7892) needs to appear in a specific invoice field.

If that works I'll draft a short checklist and send the VAT evidence template we need you to sign off on.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Hamilton <sara.hamilton@corefin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice sender & payment collection for CoreFin integration

Logan — thanks, that path sounds workable. A couple clarifications from AP after internal review: 

- We will accept emailed PDF invoices to ap@corefin.com as the immediate delivery mechanism. The PO number must be in both the invoice header and machine-readable line (our matcher looks for exact string).
- VAT evidence: please attach your VAT registration PDF to the first invoice and include your VAT number in the company block. Our tax team also needs a signed confirmation that you store VAT registration documents on your portal for audit (we can accept a signed statement).
- Collector: CoreFin prefers to pay vendors directly to the vendor's bank account. So Redwood should be the payee on the invoice (Redwood Inference, Inc.). If Redwood intends to use a third-party payment processor (e.g., Redwood Payments LLC), we will need a Collector Authorization Form with bank details and a W-9 or equivalent for the collector.

We don't need portal enrollment right away; we will revisit if we onboard more suppliers via API. For now, PDF email + the attached VAT cert is enough.

Thanks — I'll hold on completing onboarding until we receive your VAT evidence and the invoice template.

Sara Hamilton
Director, Accounts Payable
CoreFin Solutions

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hamilton <sara.hamilton@corefin.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice sender & payment collection for CoreFin integration

Hi Sara — sending next steps and the checklist so we can close this out quickly. Per Logan's proposal and your confirmation, Redwood will: 

- Issue invoices from: Redwood Inference, Inc. (billing address & VAT number included in header).
- Deliver: emailed PDF to ap@corefin.com (primary). We will also enroll the account in our portal and keep an internal mirror for records — no action required from CoreFin for that yet.
- PO handling: we'll place the PO number in the invoice header and in the machine-readable reference field to satisfy your matcher.
- VAT evidence: attached is the VAT evidence request form we use to collect the documents we will attach to the first invoice. Please complete the highlighted fields (company VAT number for CoreFin if you require reverse-charge notes) and confirm acceptance of our storage and audit access procedures.
- Collector: invoices will show Redwood Inference, Inc. as the payee. If we ultimately route payments through a third-party collector, we'll submit the Collector Authorization Form + tax docs for approval before changing remit instructions.

Action items: 
1) Sara/AP: confirm PO field format (example: "PO: CORE-7892") and return the completed VAT evidence request form.
2) Logan/Connor: prepare invoice PDF template and include sample with mocked numbers for Sara's matcher to test.
3) Kimberly: add Collector Authorization Form to our legal queue in case Redwood uses a payment processor.

I'll attach the VAT-evidence-request-form.docx for your AP team. Expect a sample invoice PDF from us by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: VAT-evidence-request-form.docx
